snippet.title: Way of the Hunter 2 | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Way of the Hunter 2 is OUT NOW on PC, PlayStation 5, and XBOX Series X|S!
 
Choose the gear that suits your hunt. Bring the company you trust. Share the trail, the knowledge you carry, and the stories worth remembering. Pack the right ammo so when the moment comes, your shot feels certain and true.
 
The hunt begins now with Way of the Hunter 2.
